citations.claim: EW approach 1 green with emergency active, 0s all-red provided
NS still yellow, no all-red phase occurred before EW green

counterfactual.change: Removed the emergency event at t=204; without preemption the controller completes yellow then 3s all-red before EW green, so all_red_clearance is not violated.

explanation: Emergency event at t=204 forces EW green immediately while NS was in yellow at step 203, bypassing the required 3s all-red clearance. Step 203 shows NS yellow, step 204 jumps directly to EW green with 0s all-red counted. Removing the emergency restores normal fixed-time cycling with proper all-red.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 3 s)

vision_note: At step 203 the NS approach shows yellow while EW is held on red, indicating the end of the NS phase. At step 204 EW is already showing green with no prolonged all-red between, so the signal jumps directly from NS yellow to opposing green.
